job: Sign up for a product's newsletter after seeing what an issue holds and how often it comes.
purpose: The newsletter's page: the sign-up first (fd-site-cta split with the page's h1, a consent line and every state), the four parts every issue holds as numbered cells, the latest issue as mail clients receive it (fire/email's newsletter example in a frame, reading width), then past issues as dated rows, five at a time with Show more.
useWhen: A page to link the newsletter from.

avoidWhen.when: A news page of releases and fixes.
A sign-in or sign-up to the product itself.

sections.why: An editorial page, like the changelog it complements.
Signing up is why the page exists, so the form opens it, beside what the newsletter is and how often.
The four parts every issue holds, in their order.
The latest issue as an email in a frame at reading width: the specimen is the same content as fire/email's example.
Past issues as dated rows with their number.
The page ends on the brand: a newsletter is the brand's voice.
